items.title: "Vox Populi" Storyboards
items.summary: A cyborg monster hunter kidnaps a child that's under the protection of a grim reaper, hoping to lure him close so that he can be the first person to ever kill a reaper. However, the plan works a bit too well...Watch the animatic version on my YouTube! (@joshquatch2980)https://youtu.be/LXVorr2x1t4?si=A-m6uadce8cTM8zjAll characters and art belong to Joshua A. Manning. Inspired by and using lyrics from the song "Vox Populi" from "Hazbin Hotel", which belongs to SpindleHorse, A24, and Amazon

items.title: "111 Winchester" Storyboards
items.summary: While investigating a mystery, teen superhero Olive McGuire gets a tip to investigate a run-down house in the woods, bringing her two closest confidants as backup. What she doesn't know is something sinister is waiting for them inside...Watch the animatic version on my YouTube! (@joshquatch2980)https://youtu.be/ltZQQgnKcTw?si=B9UwX3cieZpcqkX0All characters and art belong to Joshua A. Manning. Based off of the song "111 Winchester" by I the Mighty.
